title: Term by term: how much of the ⟨2,4,5;32⟩ and ⟨3,3,6;40⟩ ℤ[1/2] schemes can be made 2-integral
statement: Let K be a field of characteristic 0 and call a subring A ⊆ K 2-admissible if it has a ring homomorphism to a field of characteristic 2 (e.g. ℤ, ℤ_(2), ℤ₂, valuation rings with 2 in the maximal ideal). For an equivalent form (λ_r U a_r V⁻¹, μ_r V b_r W⁻¹, (λ_r μ_r)⁻¹ W c_r U⁻¹) of a rational scheme, a term is A-integral if all its coefficients lie in A. With t(r,s,u) = tr(a_r b_s c_u): if a product of such traces whose three index multisets coincide is a rational number of negative 2-adic valuation, the terms occurring in it are never all A-integral. Consequently, for every K, every equivalent form and every 2-admissible A: (1) no term of the pinned ⟨3,3,6;40⟩ ℤ[1/2] scheme (attributed to Smirnov 2013) is A-integral (t(r,r,r) = 3/2 for 16 terms and 5/4 for 24); (2) at least 20 of the 32 terms of the pinned ⟨2,4,5;32⟩ ℤ[1/2] scheme of AlphaEvolve are not A-integral (exact minimum hitting set of the obstruction hypergraph built from a-pairs t(r,q,q)t(q,r,r), b-pairs t(q,r,q)t(r,q,r), c-pairs t(r,r,q)t(q,q,r) and 3-cycles t(r,s,q)t(q,r,s)t(s,q,r); 18 without the c-pairs), and an explicit equivalent form over ℚ has exactly 12 terms with all coefficients in ℤ and 20 terms that are not ℤ_(2)-integral, so for every 2-admissible A, in particular ℤ, the minimum over all equivalent forms over K is exactly 20. Files (read from the data/ folder of theorems/no-integral-form-z-half-schemes) and term numbering as in that note.

sources.authors: Moran, Y.; Schwartz, O.; Yuan, S.
sources.title: Complex to Rational Fast Matrix Multiplication
sources.note: Credited as the base (not used as evidence); full text of v1 read. Proposition 3 and §3.2: with Proposition 3 as the tool, they state that the ⟨3,3,6,40⟩ ℤ[1/2] algorithm found by Smirnov has no ℤ equivalent form (some single trace is not an integer), and that a ⟨2,4,5,32⟩ algorithm over ℤ[1/2], which they attribute to Hopcroft and Kerr, has none 'for the same reason' as their ⟨4,4,4,48⟩ example. They print neither scheme and identify no files; whether their statements concern the pinned files is open (see the pending note of theorems/no-integral-form-z-half-schemes, which proves the statement for the pinned files). §5 (open problem 1) asks for a necessary and sufficient condition. Their integrality statements concern ℤ and all terms at once; the per-term statements, the exact value 20, the generalisation from ℤ to all 2-admissible rings and the mixed-trace invariants beyond the single traces t(r,r,r) are not in the paper.
